Create a remarkably convincing high-end commercial photograph of a small unbranded amber glass citrus drink bottle with a matte deep olive screw cap, plain ivory paper label with absolutely no writing, and an orange liquid visible through amber glass. Bottle caught mid-air tilted about 15 degrees, with a single thin ribbon of real water curling behind it and a sliced blood orange low in frame. Bottle is the single unmistakable subject and fully visible with generous margin around cap and base. Hard late-afternoon sunlight from camera left, crisp asymmetric shadows on a warm pale apricot plaster backdrop, real water droplets and imperfect paper fibers. Art direction: contemporary independent beverage campaign, photographed on a medium-format camera with a fast strobe freezing the water. Tangible glass, physically plausible refraction, controlled highlights, restrained orange and dark olive palette. Compelling editorial composition with depth, no stock-photo beige plinth, no flowers, no fantasy, no haze, no neon, no artificial glow, no excessively polished CGI. No typography, lettering, logos, badges, interface, borders or watermark. This is an illustrative fictional product, not a real brand.
